commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
SHA=d1d7b9ec21d2d8e4bcb293559c5133013455c882
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --short)"
echo '[AGENT_PROGRESS] preflash_serial_inventory'
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
for port in sorted(list_ports.comports(), key=lambda item: item.device):
    vid = f'{port.vid:04X}' if port.vid is not None else '----'
    pid = f'{port.pid:04X}' if port.pid is not None else '----'
    print(f'PORT device={port.device} vidpid={vid}:{pid} manufacturer={port.manufacturer!r} product={port.product!r} serial={port.serial_number!r} location={port.location!r}')
PY
PORT_S3="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
source scripts/source_idf.sh
PROBE="$(python -m esptool --port "$PORT_S3" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$PROBE"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] verified_preflash_esp32s3_port=$PORT_S3"
PORT="$PORT_S3" GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$SHA" bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] flash_complete sha=$SHA port=$PORT_S3"
sleep 3
PORT_POST="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
POST_PROBE="$(python -m esptool --port "$PORT_POST" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$POST_PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$POST_PROBE"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] verified_postflash_esp32s3_port=$PORT_POST"

set -euo pipefail
SHA=d1d7b9ec21d2d8e4bcb293559c5133013455c882
PORT_S3="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
OUT=build/stage27c-smoke-20260902-d1d7b9e-v2
rm -rf "$OUT"
.venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT_S3" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 900 --progress-seconds 60 --expected-sha "$SHA" --max-scd-age-ms 15000 --max-tp-age-ms 60000 --max-xiaomi-age-ms 30000 --require-sd --strict
echo '[AGENT_PROGRESS] physical_smoke_summary'
